article.headline: Erik Timko, Niels Lane both score 17 to help Delaware cruise past Monmouth 84-64
article.description: — Erik Timko and Niels Lane scored 17 points apiece to lead Delaware to an 84-64 victory over Monmouth on Saturday.
article.linkText: Erik Timko, Niels Lane both score 17 to help Delaware cruise past Monmouth 84-64
article.story: NEWARK, Del. -- — Erik Timko and Niels Lane scored 17 points apiece to lead Delaware to an 84-64 victory over Monmouth on Saturday. Timko had three steals for the Fightin' Blue Hens (8-7, 1-1 Coastal Athletic Association). Lane made 7 of 14 shot. John Camden had 15 points. Abdi Bashir Jr. led the way for the Hawks (3-12, 1-1) with 20 points. Cornelius Robinson Jr. had 10 points and Madison Durr scored nine. Delaware entered halftime up 51-27. Lane paced the team in scoring in the first half with 13 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
